name: Starter D: how deep do we defend?
engine: Sit back, keep one foul in hand for the attack that matters, then turn every clean stop into an attack with a head start.
about: Defence and transition. On their attacks, covering, dropping back, blocking and marking are +1, and tackling and pressing -1; a stop near your box wins you the ball, and the attack that starts from a won ball finds their team stretched (Sit deep). When their attack is in midfield or at the edge of your box, Rodri can pull their man down: their attack stops and he is booked, after which he cannot do it again and his tackles, presses, interceptions and double teams are -1 (Tactical fouler, Rodri). A clean win on defence gives the attack it starts +1, and in that attack the edges you carry add up (Defence into attack, captain Rodri).
decisions: Cover and drop back rather than tackle: the stop is what starts your attack.
Rodri's foul works once: spend it on the attack that would hurt most.
After a clean stop, go forward at once: the edges add up in that attack.
